gloss: somewhat thick; on the thick side; plumpish

definitions.gloss: somewhat thick; on the thick/heavy side; plumpish
definitions.explanation: Indicates something or someone is a little thicker or heavier than average. The め suffix softens the adjective, making it less direct than {太|ふと}い.

examples.japanese: {太|ふと}めの{麺|めん}が{好|す}きだ。
{太|ふと}めのペンで{書|か}いてください。
examples.english: Please write with a thicker pen.

examples.japanese: {少|すこ}し{太|ふと}めの{体型|たいけい}だが、{健康|けんこう}には{問題|もんだい}ない。
examples.english: He's slightly on the heavy side, but there are no health issues.

notes:
Formed by adding the suffix め to the adjective {太|ふと}い. The め suffix creates a softer, approximate expression. Can describe both objects (thick noodles, thick lines) and people's body types (plumpish), though when referring to people it serves as a more polite or indirect way of saying {太|ふと}い.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {太|ふと}めの{麺|めん}: thicker noodles
- {太|ふと}めの{糸|いと}: thicker thread
- {太|ふと}めの{体型|たいけい}: a heavier build
- {太|ふと}めに{切|き}る: to cut into thicker pieces

RELATED WORDS:
- {細|ほそ}め: on the thin side — the opposite
- {短|みじか}め: on the short side — same pattern
- {大|おお}きめ: on the large side — same pattern
